filing_fee_notes: Mail formation costs 135; online or in-person expedited filing costs 155. Name reservation costs 35 by mail or 55 online/in person.
registered_agent_rules: A registered agent is optional. A physical Minnesota registered office is required; a P.O. box alone is insufficient. Any named agent must be located at that office.
standard_processing_time: Mail is processed in receipt order; a fixed mail turnaround was not confirmed.
expedite_options: Online formation costs 155 and is typically processed in 2-5 business days. In-person filing by appointment costs 155 and is processed while you wait.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Minnesota Department of Employment and Economic Development, Unemployment Insurance
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and keep a Minnesota registered office. File the free annual renewal to stay active.
common_mistake: Assuming a free annual renewal does not need to be filed.
notes: Domestic Chapter 322C LLC scope. Renewal fee is 0 for an active domestic LLC; reinstatement is a different filing. First-renewal-year exception, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed. Portal URL is the official business filing and search gateway.
